dslRule:
<!id: remove-space-before-assignment-in-declaration>
<!description: Removes an extra space before the assignment operator (=) in variable declarations (local or field).
This transforms `Type var = init;` into `Type var= init;` for stylistic consistency.
>
<!severity: INFO>

$Type $var = $init;
=>
$Type $var= $init;
;;
summary: Remove extra space before the assignment operator in variable declarations.
